dedupe_keys.name: geosenegal geographic database download platform anat

description: GéoSénégal is the national infrastructure for geographic data of Senegal, and its geographic database page is a platform for downloading geospatial data produced by government bodies, supplied by the national land planning agency ANAT. It offers normalised vector data at 1:50,000, 1:200,000 and 1:1,000,000, land cover mapping at 1:50,000, vector land cover data, ALOS satellite ortho-images at 2.5 metres, and digital terrain models at 5, 30 and 90 metres. The wider portal also lists a map library, conditions of use, a description of services, the mining and petroleum cadastres, the Senegalese spatial reference system and other government GIS portals. The page says the data can be downloaded free of charge by everyone; the terms are in the conditions of use, which were not read. Caveats: the page does not give the date of each layer or the themes inside the vector sets, and the site is in French. Coverage is Senegal. It supports hazard exposure analysis and multi-sector infrastructure mapping, such as roads and settlements on flood-prone terrain; related records are the high-detail topographic viewer of Latvia and the GeoMOP spatial data infrastructure of Chile.
